title: Guest Count Change Figures for the Corporate Catering Service Agreement
content:
## Guest count figures by service level

Four figures govern a change of guest count on an order under a Corporate Catering Service Agreement: the reduction absorbed without repricing, as a percentage of the confirmed count; the hours before service after which the guest count is fixed; the increase the kitchen will take inside that deadline, as a percentage; and the hours before service by which the final guaranteed count must be given.

| Service level | Free reduction band | Guest count deadline | Increase ceiling | Guarantee deadline |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Drop-Off Catering Account | 10.0 per cent | 12 hours | 25.0 per cent | 12 hours |
| Delivered Buffet Account | 10.0 per cent | 24 hours | 20.0 per cent | 24 hours |
| Attended Buffet Account | 8.0 per cent | 48 hours | 15.0 per cent | 48 hours |
| Staffed Full-Service Catering Account | 5.0 per cent | 72 hours | 12.0 per cent | 72 hours |
| Executive Hospitality Catering Account | 5.0 per cent | 48 hours | 15.0 per cent | 48 hours |
| Campus Catering Master Account | 7.0 per cent | 96 hours | 10.0 per cent | 96 hours |

### Points of judgement

The free reduction band narrows as the service level rises, from 10.0 per cent on the two lowest levels to 5.0 per cent on the Staffed Full-Service Catering Account and the Executive Hospitality Catering Account; the Campus Catering Master Account sits between them at 7.0 per cent. The increase ceiling narrows in the same direction, from 25.0 per cent down to 10.0 per cent.

The guest count deadline and the guarantee deadline carry the same number of hours on every service level in this schedule, so a level whose count is fixed 48 hours out is also a level whose guaranteed count is due 48 hours out.
